requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: The printer must integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features, scan workflow enhancements, and manageability solutions to ease business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the core value proposition of making business management easier for SMBs and differentiates from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and AI solution stack.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Demonstrated AI productivity features in print and scan workflows; end-user can manage devices through provided solutions; meets user scenario tests.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO
requirements.Description: The printer must deliver the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) for SMB customers compared to HP's other business printers.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs and a key differentiator.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain, pricing, and consumable costs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent TCO analysis demonstrates lowest TCO among HP business printers for target use-case (AMPV ~500 pages/month).

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: The printer must feature a maintenance box that can be replaced by customers without technical assistance, with service center fallback if needed.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs with limited IT resources.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for serviceability, supply chain for replaceable parts.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: User can replace maintenance box following provided instructions; no tools or minimal tools required; validated in usability testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The printer must use keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure user safety and product reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error and damage, supports warranty claims, and enhances customer experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink bottle design, printer hardware design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Only correct ink bottle fits and dispenses; passes misfill prevention tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: A consolidated web-based portal must be provided for SMBs to manage and monitor their fleet of printers, tailored for non-IT users.
requirements.Rationale: Enables SMBs to self-manage devices without dedicated IT staff, reducing support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Cloud services, device firmware integration, user authentication.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible, user-friendly, supports core management tasks (status, configuration, alerts) for 6-15 printers.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Support
requirements.Description: The printer and associated software must support integration with HP's PaaS offerings for enhanced solutions and services.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP's goal for PaaS acceleration and coverage; enables future solution monetization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer can be registered and managed via HP's PaaS platform; integration validated in end-to-end tests.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support and Improved Print Speed
requirements.Description: For PDL SKU, the printer must support PDL/PS and achieve print speeds of at least 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19).
requirements.Rationale: Meets business productivity needs and competitive benchmarks for print speed and compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL/PS compatibility verified; print speed meets or exceeds 25/20 ppm in standard test scenarios.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: The printer must meet Blue Angel environmental certification requirements for the relevant SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability goals and competitive positioning, particularly in regulated markets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Certification documentation received; product listed as Blue Angel compliant.

requirements.Title: 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Printer must utilize at least 60% recycled content plastic in its construction, exceeding key competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates HP on sustainability and supports marketing claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: BOM and supplier documentation confirm 60% RCP; validated by internal audit.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: The printer must feature AI-powered solutions for optimizing print quality and scan accuracy, branded as Perfect Print and Perfect Scan.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses top customer needs for quality and efficiency; supports key differentiator claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Demonstrated improvement in print/scan quality in benchmark tests; feature accessible via UI/portal.

requirements.Title: Maintenance Free or Less Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Design the printer to be maintenance free or require less maintenance (i.e., fewer parts to replace over product lifetime).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces burden on SMBs with limited technical resources and aligns with competitor differentiation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product requires fewer maintenance interventions than comparable models; validated by field test data.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: The printer must include a warranty covering either 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance to SMB customers and supports reliability claims.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms published; support system configured to track both criteria.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Printer must support mobile printing via HP App and standard mobile platforms.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses evolving work patterns and customer expectations for mobility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer discoverable and usable from HP App and mobile OS print dialogs; passes connectivity and print tests from mobile devices.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Printer must support telemetry data collection for fleet management, diagnostics, and usage analytics.
requirements.Rationale: Enables proactive support, device management, and product improvement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, securely transmitted, and accessible via management portal; passes privacy and compliance review.
